about: One noul per issue title over an invented defect: 6 reworded duplicates, then 4 near-misses.

request.state: Pressing Save twice on the invented quote form creates two identical quotes instead of one.

q0.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Double-clicking Save on the quote form makes a duplicate quote

q1.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Quote form: a second Save press saves the same quote again

q2.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Two quotes are created when Save is pressed twice quickly

q3.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Repeated Save on quotes produces identical copies

q4.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Saving a quote twice leaves two of the same quote

q5.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Quote saved twice after a double press of the Save button

q6.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: The quote form's Save button is hard to see in dark mode

q7.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Deleting a quote asks for confirmation twice

q8.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: Quote totals round to the wrong decimal place

q9.instructions: Is the defect described the same defect as: The invoice form loses its notes when Save fails
